quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on his teammate's defensive and offensive growth
quotes.excerpt: he's improving a lot, especially I like the defensive effort he's giving now
quotes.quote: He's improving a lot, you know. Especially I like the defensive effort he's giving now, like blocking shots and running on offense, getting rebounds. That's the biggest key for him. And then on offense, it's our responsibility to find him, to find the lobs, find the passes for him, because he's a big guy, he's screening for us, good. So we just have to reward him for what he's doing, and I think that's our job to make him going on offense.

quotes.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on the importance of team passing and involvement
quotes.excerpt: when you pass, especially the lob, you're both happy and the whole team is happy
quotes.quote: When you pass, especially the lob, you're both happy and the whole team is happy. If you're just trying to score by your own, you may score, you may not, but you'll be the only one who will be happy. And then you have to involve everybody, I think, on the team for them then to be engaged in defense and win the games like that.
quotes.social_post: Kasparas Jakučionis on the importance of ball movement: When you pass you are both happy and the whole team is happy. If you are just trying to score on your own you may score but you will be the only one who is happy.
